title: IC2S2 Survey
subtitle: But what is similarity?
intro: We showed you several ways of embedding documents and projecting them down to two dimensions. Each combination tells a slightly different story about which documents are “similar.” We'd love to know which one matched your own intuition best.
combinationQuestion: Which combination of embedding and projection did you prefer to measure similarity between documents?
whyQuestion: Why did you prefer that combination?
whyPlaceholder: Tell us what made this combination feel right…
